title: Admin - Filter Admins by Role - Functional Test Plan
overview: Functional testing of the Admin User & Role Management - Filter Admins by Role feature on the Y4J platform. This feature provides a role filter dropdown with options (All Roles, Super Admin, Limited-Access Admin) that dynamically updates the admin list, highlights the selected filter, and works in combination with search. Covers happy path, edge cases, filter+search integration, and state management.

testCases.title: Role filter dropdown is visible with correct options
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Super Admin. User & Roles page is loaded.
steps: Locate the role filter dropdown in the toolbar area
Click on the dropdown to open it
expectedResults: Role filter dropdown is visible with default text 'All Roles'
Clicking the dropdown reveals three options: 'All Roles', 'Super Admin', 'Limited-Access Admin'
All three options are selectable
The dropdown is positioned in the toolbar area near the search bar
testCases.postconditions: Dropdown is open showing all role options

testCases.title: Selecting 'All Roles' shows all administrators
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Super Admin. Admin list contains both Super Admins and Limited-Access Admins.
expectedResults: All administrators are displayed regardless of their role
Both Super Admin and Limited-Access Admin cards are visible
The 'Showing X admins' count reflects the total number of all admins
The dropdown shows 'All Roles' as the selected value
testCases.postconditions: Full unfiltered admin list is displayed

testCases.title: Selecting 'Super Admin' filters to show only Super Admins
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Super Admin. At least one Super Admin exists in the list.
expectedResults: Only admin cards with role 'Super Admin' are displayed
No 'Limited Access Admin' cards are visible
The admin count updates to show only Super Admin count
Each visible card shows 'Super Admin' as the role label
The list updates dynamically without page reload
testCases.postconditions: Only Super Admin cards are visible

testCases.title: Selecting 'Limited-Access Admin' filters to show only Limited-Access Admins
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Super Admin. At least one Limited-Access Admin exists in the list.
expectedResults: Only admin cards with role 'Limited Access Admin' are displayed
No 'Super Admin' cards are visible
The admin count updates to show only Limited-Access Admin count
Each visible card shows 'Limited Access Admin' as the role label
The list updates dynamically without page reload
testCases.postconditions: Only Limited-Access Admin cards are visible

testCases.title: Selected filter is visually highlighted
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Super Admin. User & Roles page is loaded.
steps: Observe the default state of the filter dropdown (should show 'All Roles')
expectedResults: The currently selected filter option is visually highlighted/indicated in the dropdown
When 'Super Admin' is selected, the dropdown button text changes to reflect the selection
When 'Limited-Access Admin' is selected, the dropdown button text updates accordingly
The selected state is clearly distinguishable from unselected options

testCases.title: Filter works along with search - filter first then search
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Super Admin. Both Super Admins and Limited-Access Admins exist with distinct names.
steps: Select 'Limited-Access Admin' from the role filter
Verify only Limited-Access Admins are shown
Type a search query matching one of the visible admins (e.g., 'IvAdmin1')
expectedResults: After selecting the role filter, only Limited-Access Admins are shown
After typing the search query, results are further filtered within the Limited-Access Admins
Only admins matching BOTH the role filter AND the search query are displayed
The count updates to reflect the combined filter results
testCases.postconditions: Combined filter + search results are correct

testCases.title: Filter works along with search - search first then filter
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Super Admin. Admins with similar names but different roles exist.
steps: Type a search query that matches admins of different roles (e.g., 'admin')
Select 'Super Admin' from the role filter
expectedResults: After search, admins of all roles matching the query are shown
After applying the role filter, results narrow to only Super Admins matching the search
Both filters are applied simultaneously
The count reflects the combined results
testCases.postconditions: Search + filter combination works in either order

testCases.title: No admins in selected role shows empty state
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Super Admin. A role exists with no admins assigned (or simulate by filtering after search that eliminates all).
steps: Apply a search that narrows results
Then select a role filter that has no matching admins in the filtered set
expectedResults: No admin cards are displayed
An empty state message is shown (e.g., 'No admins found' or 'Showing 0 admins')
The page does not crash or show errors
The filter dropdown still shows the selected role
User can change the filter to see results again
testCases.postconditions: Empty state is handled gracefully for no-match filter

testCases.title: Switching filter while search is applied updates results correctly
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Super Admin. Search is active with results showing.
steps: Select 'Super Admin' from the role filter
Switch to 'Limited-Access Admin' without clearing search
expectedResults: With 'Super Admin' filter: only Super Admins matching search are shown
Switching to 'Limited-Access Admin': results update to show only Limited-Access Admins matching search
Switching to 'All Roles': all admins matching the search query are shown
Search query remains in the search field throughout filter changes
No page reload occurs during filter switches
testCases.postconditions: Filter switching with active search works correctly

testCases.title: Role filter resets to 'All Roles' on page refresh
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Super Admin. A role filter is currently selected (not 'All Roles').
steps: Select 'Super Admin' from the role filter
Refresh the page (F5 or browser refresh)
Observe the filter state and admin list
expectedResults: After page refresh, the role filter resets to 'All Roles'
The full admin list is displayed (unfiltered)
The dropdown shows 'All Roles' as the default selection
No stale filter state persists after refresh
testCases.postconditions: Filter state is reset to default after page refresh

testCases.title: Admin count updates correctly when filter changes
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Super Admin. Multiple admins of different roles exist.
steps: Note the total admin count with 'All Roles' (e.g., 'Showing 9 admins')
Note the count (should be less than total)
expectedResults: 'All Roles' shows the total count of all admins
'Super Admin' shows only the count of Super Admins
'Limited-Access Admin' shows only the count of Limited-Access Admins
Super Admin count + Limited-Access Admin count = All Roles count
Returning to 'All Roles' restores the original total count
testCases.postconditions: Admin counts are accurate for each filter state

testCases.title: Filter dropdown closes after selection
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Super Admin. User & Roles page is loaded.
steps: Click the role filter dropdown to open it
expectedResults: After selecting an option, the dropdown closes automatically
The selected option text is displayed on the dropdown button
The admin list updates to reflect the selection
No manual action is needed to close the dropdown
testCases.postconditions: Dropdown is closed with selection applied

testCases.title: Pagination resets when filter changes
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Super Admin. Admin list has multiple pages. User is on page 2.
steps: Navigate to page 2 of the admin list
Change the role filter to 'Super Admin'
expectedResults: After changing the filter, pagination resets to page 1
The first page of filtered results is displayed
User is not left on a page that may not exist for the filtered set
testCases.postconditions: Pagination is reset to page 1 after filter change

testCases.title: Filter selection persists during same session navigation
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Super Admin. A role filter is selected.
steps: Select 'Super Admin' from the role filter
Navigate away to another page (e.g., Dashboard)
Navigate back to User & Roles page
expectedResults: After navigating away and back, the filter may reset to 'All Roles' (default behavior)
OR the filter persists showing 'Super Admin' (if state is maintained)
Either behavior is acceptable as long as it's consistent
The admin list matches the displayed filter state
testCases.postconditions: Filter state is consistent with displayed results
